required_changes.requirement: Place RECONSTRUCTED_FOUNDATION_V2_V1_001 and FOUNDATION_V2_RECONSTRUCTION_AND_TARGETED_REPAIR_V1 into a fail-closed scientific hold. Do not start, retry, resume, attach to, or relaunch any model, worker, optimizer, or GPU job for this round or protocol. Disable any automatic dispatch path that could consume SCIENTIFIC_EXECUTION_GATE.json or SCIENTIFIC_EXECUTION_GATE_RERUN_01.json. Read-only remote inspection is permitted.

Preserve the existing round ID, launch configuration, terminal receipt, notification, acknowledgement, logs, ledgers, state files, and timestamps byte-for-byte. Do not rewrite, delete, overwrite, or relabel the original artifacts. Any correction must be an additive superseding artifact that cites the original SHA256 values.

Collect read-only hashes, sizes, timestamps, and contents or explicit MISSING status for the detached wrapper command and environment, raw stdout/stderr log, wrapper exit, worker exit, PID/job state, process listing, launch receipt, terminal receipt, ledger and snapshot, optimizer accounting state, progress, training result, reservation, interval records, checkpoint directory listing and file hashes, GPU observation, checked-out commit, and source hashes. Do not infer absent evidence as PASS.

Create an additive state-conflict resolution record with separate fields for launch_requested, wrapper_started, worker_started, model_loaded, optimizer_constructed, optimizer_steps, processed_tokens, scientific_gpu_training_seconds, checkpoints_written, worker_exit_code, wrapper_exit_code, and final_audit_accessed. Classify each as CONFIRMED_TRUE, CONFIRMED_FALSE, or UNKNOWN with evidence hashes. Do not use a single scientific_training_started flag as a substitute for these states.

If the preserved raw evidence confirms the current pre-optimizer failure account, add a superseding terminal classification such as INVALID_SUCCESS_RECEIPT_PRE_OPTIMIZER_FAILURE and set the orchestration round to SCIENTIFIC_STATE_CONFLICT_HOLD, not SUCCESS or CLOSED. If any optimizer work is discovered, preserve and charge its exact interval before further review.

Require every scientific launch gate to bind the exact Director directive bytes and SHA256, matching protocol and scope, decision CONTINUE or CONTINUE_WITH_WARNING, scientific_training_authorized=true, exact round or allowed condition identity, and an unconsumed authorization nonce or launch identity. Reject dummy-smoke directives, NEW_SUBPROTOCOL_REQUIRED, REQUIRE_CHANGES, REQUIRE_INFRA_REPAIR, stale directives, scope mismatches, closed protocols, and internally contradictory gates.

Propagate the real worker exit code and failure into the terminal receipt. A scientific SUCCESS receipt must include verified worker completion, optimizer and token counts, charged seconds, ledger snapshot hash, result hash, checkpoint identities, and final-audit state. Missing required scientific fields, wrapper-only success, import failure, or absent worker result must produce a fail-closed non-success receipt.

A round classified SCIENTIFIC must never be acknowledged through DUMMY_NOTIFICATION_ACK_ONLY. Bind notifications and acknowledgements to round_class, protocol_id, receipt schema, and terminal evidence; on mismatch, keep the Controller in SCIENTIFIC_STATE_CONFLICT and escalate exactly once without marking the cycle complete.

Add CPU-only regression tests covering unauthorized scientific gate rejection, closed-protocol rejection, contradictory gate rejection, wrapper-success/worker-failure propagation, missing scientific receipt fields, scientific-round dummy-ack rejection, exactly-once escalation across watchdog restart, zero-work accounting, discovered-work charging, and preservation of the original round identity.

Freeze the forensic resolution and infrastructure repairs, commit and push them on the existing non-main branch without force-push or history rewrite, verify fresh local HEAD equals git ls-remote origin SHA equals RunPod checked-out/source SHA, and submit a new hashed Director brief. The brief must request review of the resolved state only; it must not treat the preregistered rerun as authorized.
